title: Signature detail and portrait billboard
slide_intent: Compare close and distant brand cues because a signature must coexist with expressive subject matter.
strategic_value: Repeated naming can connect a quiet edge detail with a bold Dropbox portrait campaign.
demonstration: Two photographs pair a cropped architectural panel with a small signature at left and a large colorful portrait billboard at right.
practical_value: Check recognition at the signature level and at the overall campaign level.
